scope.core: Trains, specifies, or evaluates persistent assistant character, identity, values or dispositions for alignment; or directly measures safety consequences of trait training.
scope.mechanism: Explains, measures or controls alignment-relevant persona representations, selection, drift or generalization; may be inference-time rather than training.
scope.background: Foundations, measurement or enabling methods with an explicit connection to assistant character; not evidence of a character-training intervention itself.
scope.roleplay: Assigned fictional or real characters, persona fidelity, entertainment, personality imitation or user personalization without an assistant-alignment contribution.
scope.exclude: No substantive relation, or generic safety/constitutional work without a useful character connection.
scope.uncertain: Insufficient evidence or ambiguous contribution; requires further reading.
